description: Use when someone looks for a free emergency or estate planning folder (Notfallmappe, Vorsorgemappe, Notfallordner) from their district, city or state in Germany: "Notfallmappe kostenlos Landkreis Passau", "Vorsorgemappe Frankfurt PDF", "Notfallordner Bayern kostenlos". Searches the register of 55 free official folders on vorsorge-regeln.de (publisher, pages, whether the PDF is fillable, direct PDF link, check date). Without a match it lists the states covered and the free nationwide forms of the Federal Ministry of Justice. Needs only a place name or a state.

ort.description: Landkreis, Kreis oder Stadt, zum Beispiel "Passau", "Bodenseekreis", "Frankfurt am Main".
